def: to talk throughout a company, i.e. converse or (genitive case) publish

occurrences.text: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judea.
And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
